references.text: The original instruction from God to Moses to make the table of showbread out of acacia wood with the same dimensions: two cubits long, one cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.
Parallel text giving the direct command to make the table out of acacia wood with exactly the same dimensions as carried out in Exodus 37:10.
Refers to the table of showbread and its function in the tabernacle, where the Levites were to place a blue cloth over it during transport.
Solomon made the gold table for the showbread for the temple, which was a continuation of the original table made by Bezalel.
Refers to the table of showbread made of pure gold and its use in temple service.
Describes the table and the showbread as part of the furnishings of the first tent in the tabernacle, pointing back to the table that was made in Exodus 37:10.
